stem: The SEO lead wants to know which Google search queries bring visitors who go on to buy, and asks you to break the Queries report from the Search Console link down by GA4 purchases. What do you tell them?

options.text: Not per query: the Queries report holds Search Console dimensions and metrics only
Add a purchases column: the Queries report takes any GA4 metric once the link is live
Turn on site search in enhanced measurement, which adds GA4 metrics to the query rows
Publish the Search Console collection first, since publishing adds GA4 metrics to queries
